native_render_transform.transform: uniform full-frame fit with integer rounding, centered letterbox; no crop/search/warp

source_checks.historical_png_blend_sync: unknown; same artifact export lineage only; no re-render

measurement_interpretation.appearance: Actual RGB L1; affected by camera, lighting and visibility
measurement_interpretation.spatial: Core image-edge proxy unless independently reviewed Anchor/occupancy evidence exists; not 3D layout correctness
measurement_interpretation.statistical: Existing texture/multiscale edge-distribution proxies unless reviewed occupancy exists; not object density
measurement_interpretation.semantic: Reviewed evidence only; attached Group/Structural answers never become scores
measurement_interpretation.perceptual: Existing local DINO metric; crop/black-fill/aspect-ratio confounds remain; not semantic correctness
measurement_interpretation.observation: Conditional debug aggregate of core eligible records; not a formal Benchmark result
